notes.title: April Early Access Update
notes.content:
We've updated the game! Here's what's included in the latest:
[list]
    [*]Added levels 4, 8, 14, 18, and 24
    [*]Tutorial accessible from level select
    [*]Voices can now be muted
    [*]New UI design
    [*]Fixed ragdoll bugs
    [*]New graphical effects to improve visuals
    [*]Now uses cloud save
    [*]Oculus VR fixes
[/list]
Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Nebulous Early Access Update
notes.content:
We've added some new features and levels to Nebulous today!

[list]
    [*] Adjusted Tutorial
[*] Added levels 1, 5, 11, 23, and 27
[*] W, A, S, D now listed in controls section for rotating panels
[*] Screen now fades in and out when using Oculus VR
[*] Fixed VR settings sensitivity
[*] Added controller support
[*] Added windowed mode option
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates!
